title: Act on the Promotion of and Support for Village Enterprises
title_original: 마을기업 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률
full_text:
Act on the Promotion of and Support for Village Enterprises

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to contribute to improving the quality of life of local residents and overcoming the crisis of regional extinction by promoting and supporting village enterprises so as to generate local income and jobs and voluntarily resolve local problems.

Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in this Act are defined as follows:
1. The term "village enterprise" means an enterprise designated under Article 11 that is led by village residents, generates income and jobs through profit-making activities using local resources, and voluntarily resolves local problems;
2. The term "village resident" means a person whose address is within the jurisdiction of the Si/Gun/Gu under Article 2 (1) 2 of the Local Autonomy Act in which a village enterprise is located and operates; detailed criteria therefor shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 3 (Duties of the State and Local Governments)
(1) The State shall formulate comprehensive plans and implement necessary measures to promote and support village enterprises.
(2) Local governments shall formulate and implement measures necessary to promote and support village enterprises suited to local characteristics.

Article 4 (Roles and Duties of Village Enterprises)
Village enterprises shall undertake projects for the development of local communities and society and endeavor to contribute to their local communities.

Article 5 (Relationship to Other Acts)
Except as otherwise expressly provided for in other Acts, the promotion of and support for village enterprises shall be governed by this Act.

CHAPTER II FRAMEWORK FOR THE PROMOTION OF AND SUPPORT FOR VILLAGE ENTERPRISES

Article 6 (Formulation of Master Plans, Etc.)
(1) The Minister of the Interior and Safety shall formulate and implement a master plan for the promotion of and support for village enterprises (hereinafter referred to as a "master plan") every five years to promote and support village enterprises.
(2) A master plan shall include the following matters:
1. Basic goals and directions for the promotion of and support for village enterprises;
2. Measures to support village enterprises and their business activities;
3. Plans for training personnel for village enterprises and educating their representatives and members;
4. Establishment of a support framework, including village enterprise support institutions and a comprehensive information system for village enterprises;
5. Surveys of local resources for the promotion of and support for village enterprises;
6. Other matters necessary for the promotion of and support for village enterprises.
(3) Where the Minister of the Interior and Safety intends to formulate a master plan under paragraph (1), the Minister shall hear the opinions of the heads of relevant central administrative agencies. The same shall apply where the Minister intends to amend an established master plan.
(4) The Minister of the Interior and Safety shall notify the heads of relevant central administrative agencies and the Special Metropolitan City Mayor, Metropolitan City Mayors, Special Self-Governing City Mayors, Do Governors, and Special Self-Governing Province Governors (hereinafter referred to as "Mayors/Do Governors") of the master plan formulated under paragraph (3).
(5) Except as provided in paragraphs (1) through (4), matters necessary for the formulation, amendment, and implementation of master plans shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 7 (Formulation of Implementation Plans, Etc.)
(1) A Mayor/Do Governor shall formulate and implement an annual implementation plan for the promotion of and support for village enterprises for the relevant Special Metropolitan City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Do, or Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as a "City/Do") (hereinafter referred to as an "implementation plan").
(2) An implementation plan shall include the following matters:
1. Basic goals and directions for the promotion of and support for village enterprises in the relevant City/Do;
2. Establishment of a support framework for the relevant City/Do, including the operation of village enterprise support institutions;
3. The current status of village enterprises and analysis of their performance in the relevant City/Do;
4. Administrative and financial support for village enterprises in the relevant City/Do;
5. Education of the representatives and members of village enterprises in the relevant City/Do;
6. Other matters prescribed by ordinance that are necessary for the promotion of and support for village enterprises in the relevant City/Do.
(3) Where a Mayor/Do Governor intends to formulate an implementation plan, the Mayor/Do Governor shall hear the opinions of village enterprises located in the relevant City/Do and the heads of Si/Gun/Gu (in the case of a Gu, referring to the head of an autonomous Gu). The same shall apply where the Mayor/Do Governor intends to amend an established implementation plan.
(4) Except as provided in paragraphs (1) through (3), matters necessary for the formulation and implementation of implementation plans shall be prescribed by ordinance.

Article 8 (Fact-Finding Surveys)
(1) The Minister of the Interior and Safety and Mayors/Do Governors shall conduct fact-finding surveys on the activities and business status of village enterprises every two years to efficiently formulate and implement policies related to the promotion of and support for village enterprises.
(2) Where necessary for fact-finding surveys under paragraph (1), the Minister of the Interior and Safety and Mayors/Do Governors may request that the heads of relevant central administrative agencies, the heads of local governments, and the heads of relevant institutions and organizations submit necessary data. In such cases, a person receiving such a request shall comply unless there is a compelling reason not to do so.
(3) Matters necessary for the methods, subjects, and scope of fact-finding surveys under paragraphs (1) and (2), and other related matters, shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 9 (Central Committee for the Promotion of and Support for Village Enterprises)
(1) A Central Committee for the Promotion of and Support for Village Enterprises (hereinafter referred to as the "Central Committee") may be established within the Ministry of the Interior and Safety to efficiently implement policies for the promotion of and support for village enterprises. However, if there is another committee suitable for performing the functions of the Central Committee, that committee may perform those functions in place of the Central Committee, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) The Central Committee shall deliberate on the following matters:
1. The basic direction of policies for the promotion of and support for village enterprises;
2. Evaluation of the business activities of village enterprises;
3. Matters concerning the formulation and amendment of the master plan under Article 6;
4. Matters concerning the designation of village enterprises under Article 11;
5. Matters concerning awards to village enterprises under Article 18;
6. Other matters prescribed by Presidential Decree for the promotion of and support for village enterprises.
(3) Matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Central Committee under paragraph (1) and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 10 (City/Do Committee for the Promotion of and Support for Village Enterprises)
(1) A Mayor/Do Governor may establish a City/Do Committee for the Promotion of and Support for Village Enterprises in the City/Do to deliberate on the implementation plan, measures to support village enterprises within the relevant jurisdiction, and other such matters. However, if there is another organization that meets the conditions prescribed by Presidential Decree, that organization may perform the functions of the City/Do Committee for the Promotion of and Support for Village Enterprises in its place.
(2) Matters necessary for the composition and operation of the City/Do Committee for the Promotion of and Support for Village Enterprises under paragraph (1) and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by ordinance of the relevant local government within the scope prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Chapter III Designation of and Support for Village Enterprises

Article 11 (Designation of Village Enterprises, etc.)
(1) The Minister of the Interior and Safety may designate an enterprise that meets all of the following requirements as a village enterprise and promote and support it:
1. Its representative shall be a village resident;
2. It shall satisfy the requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree concerning the number of capital contributors, capital contribution ratios, and capital contribution ratios among related persons;
3. It shall take the form of a juristic person, such as a juristic person under the Civil Act or a company under the Commercial Act;
4. Its activities shall be centered on the local community in which the village enterprise is located;
5. It shall meet other requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) Matters necessary for the procedures and details of the designation of village enterprises under paragraph (1) and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 12 (Support for Village Enterprises, etc.)
(1) The State and local governments may provide administrative and financial support for the following matters necessary for the establishment and operation of village enterprises:
1. Provision of professional advice and information concerning management, law, technology, taxation, labor affairs, accounting, marketing, and other matters;
2. Education and training to improve the abilities of representatives and members of village enterprises;
3. Financial assistance and loans for facility expenses, land purchase costs, and other such costs;
4. Leasing and use of State-owned and public property and goods;
5. Other matters prescribed by Presidential Decree as necessary for the establishment and operation of village enterprises.
(2) When formulating and implementing measures to promote village enterprises or providing support for village enterprises, the State and local governments may give preferential treatment to village enterprises established and operated in depopulation areas designated pursuant to Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Special Act on Support for Depopulation Areas.
(3) When formulating and implementing measures to promote village enterprises or providing support for village enterprises, the State and local governments may give preferential treatment to village enterprises in which the proportion of members who are young people as defined in the main clause of Article 3, subparagraph 1 of the Framework Act on Youth is not less than the proportion prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 13 (Revocation of Designation of Village Enterprises)
(1) The Minister of the Interior and Safety may revoke the designation of a village enterprise designated under Article 11 if it falls under any of the following subparagraphs. However, the Minister shall revoke its designation if it falls under subparagraph 1:
1. Where it has obtained designation as a village enterprise by fraud or other improper means;
2. Where it no longer meets the requirements for designation under Article 11;
3. Where it has received, or attempted to receive, financial support under this Act or other statutes or regulations by fraud or other improper means;
4. Where it has failed to comply with a corrective order under Article 19 (3).
(2) The Minister of the Interior and Safety shall hold a hearing before revoking a designation under paragraph (1).
(3) Matters necessary for the procedures for revoking the designation of village enterprises and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Chapter IV Establishment of a Foundation for the Promotion of Village Enterprises

Article 14 (Village Enterprise Day)
(1) To promote understanding of village enterprises and encourage their activities, the State shall designate a day prescribed by Presidential Decree as Village Enterprise Day and the one-week period beginning on Village Enterprise Day as Village Enterprise Week.
(2) The State and local governments shall endeavor to hold events and conduct other activities consistent with the purpose of Village Enterprise Day.

Article 15 (Establishment and Operation of a Village Enterprise Information System, etc.)
(1) The Minister of the Interior and Safety may establish and operate a village enterprise information system to collect, process, and analyze information on the formulation and implementation of policies for village enterprises, statistics, and other matters.
(2) The Minister of the Interior and Safety may request the heads of relevant central administrative agencies, the heads of local governments, and the heads of relevant institutions and organizations to provide data necessary for establishing and operating the village enterprise information system under paragraph (1). In such cases, a person who receives such a request shall comply with it unless there is a special reason not to do so.
(3) Matters necessary for the establishment and operation of the village enterprise information system, requests for the provision of data, and other matters under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 16 (Village Enterprise Support Institutions)
(1) A Mayor/Do Governor may establish or designate a village enterprise support institution (hereinafter referred to as a "support institution" in this Article) in each City/Do to perform duties necessary for the promotion of and support for village enterprises.
(2) A support institution shall perform the following duties:
1. Identification of local resources for the promotion of village enterprises;
2. Review of village enterprises' performance and their business reports;
3. Identification and publicizing of examples of outstanding village enterprises;
4. Local fact-finding surveys and research concerning village enterprises;
5. Support for the establishment and operation of networks of village enterprises;
6. Support for education and consulting to strengthen the capacities of village enterprises;
7. Management support for village enterprises.
(3) A Mayor/Do Governor may provide support, within budgetary limits, for expenses necessary for the operation of support institutions and the performance of the duties under paragraph (2).
(4) A Mayor/Do Governor may, to the extent necessary to guide and supervise the work of a support institution, order the institution to report on its work or have public officials under the Mayor/Do Governor's authority investigate the status of that work.
(5) Except as provided in paragraphs (1) through (4), matters necessary for the establishment, designation, and operation of support institutions and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 17 (Village Enterprise Association)
(1) Village enterprises may establish a Village Enterprise Association for the sound development and enhanced competitiveness of village enterprises, etc.
(2) The Village Enterprise Association shall perform the following duties:
1. Conducting surveys and research and making policy recommendations concerning the establishment and revitalization of village enterprises;
2. Publicity to raise awareness of and expand participation in village enterprises;
3. Education and training to strengthen the capabilities of representatives and members of village enterprises;
4. Establishing and operating a system for networking and cooperation among village enterprises;
5. Networking, cooperation, and coordination among private institutions and organizations to identify and promote village enterprises.
(3) The Village Enterprise Association shall be a corporation and shall be formed by registering its incorporation after obtaining authorization from the Minister of the Interior and Safety.
(4) Except as provided in this Act, the provisions of the Civil Act concerning incorporated associations shall apply mutatis mutandis to the Village Enterprise Association.

Article 18 (Awards)
The Minister of the Interior and Safety may select and grant awards to village enterprises with outstanding business performance and operations to promote and encourage village enterprises.

Article 19 (Supervision)
(1) The Minister of the Interior and Safety shall guide and supervise village enterprises and may, where necessary to ascertain whether designation under Article 11 is appropriate, require the relevant village enterprise to report on matters concerning its business and property or have public officials under the Minister's jurisdiction inspect the books and documents of the relevant village enterprise and other necessary matters.
(2) A public official who conducts an inspection under paragraph (1) shall carry a certificate indicating the official's authority and present it to the persons concerned.
(3) Where the Minister of the Interior and Safety discovers any unlawful or improper fact as a result of a report or inspection under paragraphs (1) and (2), the Minister may order the village enterprise to take corrective action.

CHAPTER V SUPPLEMENTARY PROVISIONS

Article 20 (Delegation and Entrustment of Authority and Duties)
(1) Part of the authority of the Minister of the Interior and Safety under this Act may be delegated to the heads of local governments, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) Among the duties of the Minister of the Interior and Safety and local governments under this Act, the following duties may be entrusted to institutions, corporations, and organizations that have specialized capabilities and perform specialized functions concerning village enterprises, as prescribed by Presidential Decree:
1. Duties concerning fact-finding surveys under Article 8;
2. Duties concerning support for village enterprises under Article 12;
3. Other duties prescribed by Presidential Decree as necessary in relation to the promotion of and support for village enterprises.
(3) The Minister of the Interior and Safety and the heads of local governments may provide necessary administrative and financial support to enable institutions, corporations, and organizations entrusted with duties under paragraph (2) to perform those duties smoothly.

Article 21 (Prohibition of Use of the Same Name)
No person other than a village enterprise shall use the name "village enterprise."

Article 22 (Administrative Fines)
(1) An administrative fine not exceeding 10 million won shall be imposed on any of the following persons:
1. A person who has obtained designation as a village enterprise under Article 11 by false or other improper means;
2. A person who has failed to comply with an order to take corrective action under Article 19 (3).
(2) An administrative fine not exceeding one million won shall be imposed on a person who has used the name "village enterprise" in violation of Article 21.
(3) Administrative fines under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be imposed and collected by the Minister of the Interior and Safety, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

ADDENDA <Act No. 21017, August 14, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force one year after the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Designation of Village Enterprises)
A village enterprise designated by the Minister of the Interior and Safety as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed a village enterprise designated under Article 11. However, the village enterprise shall meet the requirements under Article 11 within one year after this Act enters into force.

Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Village Enterprise Support Institutions)
A village enterprise support institution established or designated by a Mayor/Do Governor as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed a village enterprise support institution established or designated under Article 16.

Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning the Village Enterprise Association)
A Village Enterprise Association established with authorization from the Minister of the Interior and Safety as at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed a Village Enterprise Association established under Article 17.

Article 5 (Amendment to Another Act)
Part of the Special Act on the Promotion of and Support for Urban Regeneration shall be amended as follows:

Article 2 (1) 9 shall be amended to read as follows:

9. "Village enterprise" means a village enterprise under Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Village Enterprises.
